title: Root-to-Leaf Target
description: Given a binary tree and a target sum, determine whether there exists a root-to-leaf path whose node values add exactly to the target.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; node values and target are integers; the root is never missing.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values in level-order representation, where -1 represents a missing node. Third line: target sum.
outputFormat: Print YES if a root-to-leaf path has the target sum, otherwise print NO.
hints: Carry the remaining required sum while traversing from the root to each leaf.

examples.explanation: No root-to-leaf path produces a sum of 19.
